dimensions.label: Market
dimensions.description: Price quality, liquidity, activity, distribution and execution.

dimensions.label: Control
dimensions.description: Who can change, pause or freeze the token and its accounts.

dimensions.label: Legal / evidence
dimensions.description: Evidence that the off-chain shares and reserve claim exist.

dimensions.label: DeFi composability
dimensions.description: Whether a protocol can custody the token and enforce a default without discretionary issuer help.

rules.label: Price tracking
rules.description: How far the on-chain price sits from a reference price for the same underlying share.

rules.label: Pool liquidity
rules.description: Dollar liquidity the venues report behind the token, i.e. how much can be traded at all.

rules.label: Organic flow
rules.description: Whether the 24 h trading looks like many real traders rather than a handful of bots.

rules.label: Failed swaps
rules.description: Share of the sampled pool signatures that reverted instead of settling a swap.

rules.label: Holder concentration
rules.description: Supply share of the largest wallet this repo cannot name (issuer keys and burn addresses excluded).

rules.label: Reserve verification
rules.description: Strength of the issuer evidence that the shares behind the token exist (0–5).

rules.label: DeFi enforceability
rules.description: Whether a smart-contract lender can custody the token and seize realisable value after default without discretionary issuer cooperation.

thresholds.caution: usable with explicit protocol support or eligibility conditions
thresholds.warning: generic escrow or meaningful default enforcement is blocked

rules.label: Authority keys
rules.description: How the mint, freeze, permanent-delegate and rebase authorities are held.

rules.label: Trading pause
rules.description: Whether transfers or issuer trading are paused right now.

rules.label: Frozen accounts
rules.description: Frozen token accounts among the top 20 holders — transfers there are blocked.

rules.label: Venue spread
rules.description: Gap between the cheapest and the dearest venue pricing the same token.
